title: feat: ConditionalFormatting protocol adaptation — expression & field rule interop
body:
Spec uses `{ condition: "status == 'overdue'", style: { backgroundColor: 'red' } }` while ObjectUI uses `{ field, operator, value, style }`. This PR implements full dual-format support across types, core evaluator, and ListView rendering.

### Changes

- **`packages/types/src/objectql.ts`** — Named union types following the `QuickFilterItem` pattern:
  - `ObjectUIConditionalFormattingRule` (field/operator/value format)
  - `SpecConditionalFormattingRule` (condition/style format)
  - `ConditionalFormattingRule` union type
  - `ListViewSchema`, `NamedListView`, and `ObjectGridSchema` updated to use the union type

- **`packages/types/src/index.ts`** — Exported all three new types

- **`packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts`** — Zod validator updated with `z.union()` to accept both ObjectUI and Spec formats

- **`packages/core/src/ExpressionEvaluator.ts`** — Added `evaluatePlainCondition()` convenience function for safe expression evaluation with record context. Supports both template expressions (`${data.amount > 1000}`) and plain expressions (`status == 'overdue'`). Record fields are spread into the evaluator context so both direct (`status`) and namespaced (`data.status`) references resolve.

- **`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`** — Refactored `evaluateConditionalFormatting` to use `evaluatePlainCondition` and proper union type narrowing via `in` operator checks for discriminating between Spec and ObjectUI rule formats.

- **`packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ConditionalFormatting.test.ts`** — 8 new tests: plain condition matching, numeric comparisons, compound `&&`, style merging, invalid expression fallback, mixed Spec + ObjectUI rule arrays with fallthrough

- **`packages/core/src/evaluator/__tests__/ExpressionEvaluator.test.ts`** — 6 new tests for `evaluatePlainCondition`: direct field references, numeric comparisons, compound conditions, template expression support, invalid expression fallback, non-boolean result handling

- **`ROADMAP.md`** — Updated conditional formatting entry with full implementation details

### Notes

- The union type pattern mirrors the existing `QuickFilterItem = ObjectUIQuickFilterItem | SpecQuickFilterItem` approach
- `data` is set after spread to avoid collision if record contains a `data` property
- All 494 tests pass across types, core, and plugin-list packages
